sketches.notes: Custom profile: L-bracket cross-section (custom profile, NOT a regular polygon). The sketch lies on the XZ plane, therefore sketch-local x = world X and sketch-local y = world Z. Closed CCW outline built with BuildLine + Polyline/RadiusArc + make_face(): (1) line (-40,0)->(40,0) = base underside at world Z=0, base front free edge at X=-40 (BASE_FRONT_EDGE_X = -40 - BASE_LENGTH_X/2 = -40) and base rear end at X=+40 (BASE_END_X = +40); (2) line (40,0)->(40,60) = arm OUTER face, flush with the base rear end face at X=+40 so OVERALL_X stays 80; (3) line (40,60)->(32,60) = arm top face at Z=60 (ARM_HEIGHT_Z); (4) line (32,60)->(32,13) = arm INNER face at X=ARM_INNER_FACE_X=32, running down to the inner-fillet tangent point, tangent Z = BASE_THICKNESS_Z + INNER_FILLET_RADIUS = 8 + 5 = 13; (5) CONCAVE inner fillet arc of radius R=5 from (32,13) to (27,8) with centre at (27,13) and arc midpoint at (30.5355, 9.4645) - use RadiusArc or ThreePointArc through that midpoint; the arc is tangent to the arm inner face line x=32 at (32,13) and tangent to the base top face line y=8 at (27,8), and it ADDS material into the inner corner at (32,8) (inside fillet, not an outer rounding); fillet tangent on base top X = ARM_INNER_FACE_X - INNER_FILLET_RADIUS = 32 - 5 = 27; (6) line (27,8)->(-40,8) = base top face at Z=8; (7) close (-40,8)->(-40,0) = base front free edge at X=-40. Do NOT use RegularPolygon. All vertices except the arc are sharp 90-degree corners - no other corner may be rounded (no external edge rounding). Extruding this closed profile by 50 mm yields a single continuous solid: base 80 x 50 x 8 and arm 8 x 50 x 60 fused with the R5 concave fillet.

steps.label: Extrude L-bracket cross-section 50 mm along Y (base + arm + R5 inner fillet as one solid)
steps.notes: Sketch plane XZ offset -25.0 places the profile at Y = +25; the positive (plane-normal, -Y) extrusion spans Y = +25 to Y = -25, i.e. the full BASE_WIDTH_Y = 50 mm, symmetric about the XZ plane (Y = 0) - the arm spans the whole width, not a partial strip. Resulting single continuous solid: base block X=-40..+40, Y=-25..+25, Z=0..8; vertical arm X=+32..+40, Y=-25..+25, Z=0..60 (rises from the base bottom Z=0, projecting ARM_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE = 60 - 8 = 52 mm above the base top face at Z=8); concave R5 fillet tangent to the base top face at X=27, Z=8 and to the arm inner face at X=32, Z=13, running the full 50 mm in Y. Overall extents = 80 x 50 x 60.

steps.label: 10 mm dia vertical through-hole in the base, 20 mm from the front edge and on the Y=0 centreline
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z (vertical), penetrating the full BASE_THICKNESS_Z = 8 mm, base Z = 0..8. Use a cylinder with at least 1 mm overshoot past BOTH faces (e.g. Z = -2 to Z = +10, height 12 mm) so the cut is complete and the solid stays water-tight. Centre: X = HOLE_POS_X = -20 (HOLE_FROM_FRONT_EDGE = 20 mm from the free front edge at X = -40), Y = HOLE_POS_Y = 0 (HOLE_FROM_SIDE_EDGE = 25 mm from each side edge, on the symmetry plane). HOLE_RADIUS = 5 mm. The arm inner face is at X = +32, so the hole edge at X = -15 is far away and the drill does NOT intersect the vertical arm. This is the only subtractive feature.

revision_history.note: Initial design. Base+arm+inner R5 fillet are realised as ONE extruded closed L-profile on the XZ plane (sketch 'l-profile', built via TODO_AIDER as a custom profile with a concave RadiusArc R5 at the base/arm junction) so that the inner fillet is a true material-adding solid feature across the full 50 mm width. No 3D fillet/chamfer step is added because Iron Rule/design constraints forbid rounding any external edge (edge_selector keywords such as 'horizontal' would also round the base and arm outer edges). Only subtractive feature is the 10 mm Z through-hole in the base.
